title: Verify your Discord account
explanation: Check in at Hack the Hill III first, then use the verification button in Discord.
verified: Your Discord account is verified. You can return to Discord.
session-required: Open your day-of access link and activate your pass in this browser, then return here. An organiser sign-in does not provide participant access.
invalid: This verification link is missing, invalid, or expired. Generate a new personal link in Discord.
conflict: This participant or Discord account is already linked to a different account. Ask an organiser for help.
unavailable: Verification is temporarily unavailable. Try again. If your link expires, generate a new one in Discord.
